width.rule: ≤4y: walk-forward conformal P10/P90 of AR1-relative log errors; 10y/30y: Idle/Redline corridor around Cruise; fan tapers 4y→10y

method.disclaimer: P50 mean-reverts toward Cruise via AR(1) (same family as Models short-term). P10/P90 for ≤4y are walk-forward conformal envelopes of AR1 forecast errors — empirical coverage targets, NOT confidence intervals (independent windows are small). When enough ledger calls have matured, a shrunk/capped closed-loop bias (and optional band widen) nudges ≤4y forecasts from published→outcome misses; this is still not a CI. 10y/30y use the Models Idle/Redline corridor as a scenario ribbon only. Live ledger freezes 30d/90d/1y/2y/4y.

horizons.label: 10 years
horizons.caveat: Scenario only — corridor is Models Idle/Redline (empirical residual envelope), not a walk-forward-calibrated CI. Independent sample at this horizon is effectively zero.

horizons.label: 30 years
horizons.caveat: Scenario only — corridor is Models Idle/Redline (empirical residual envelope), not a walk-forward-calibrated CI. Independent sample at this horizon is effectively zero.

ensemble.name: Walk-forward conformal envelope
ensemble.trust_note: 1y indep windows ~12.8; asymmetric; not a CI

ensemble.name: Idle / Redline corridor
ensemble.trust_note: Same empirical residual envelope as Models — scenario ribbon, not calibrated long-CI

ensemble.name: Monthly live ledger
ensemble.trust_note: Cards outside those horizons are labeled scenario-only

ensemble.name: Ledger closed-loop nudge
ensemble.role: shrunk bias + optional band widen from matured published misses
ensemble.trust_note: status=inactive_waiting_for_matured; matured=0; caps ±0.10 log10; not a CI recalibration

learning.ledger_note: Live ledger scores 30d/90d/1y/2y/4y; other cards are scenario-labeled. Closed-loop applies shrunk ledger bias when matured sample clears min_n.
